# @three-ws/pumpfun-mcp

> Free, read-only pump.fun + Solana MCP server — token discovery, on-chain bonding-curve & holder analysis, creator fee-claim tracking, SNS resolution, KOL signals, and swap quotes. No API keys.

@three-ws/pumpfun-mcp is a Model Context Protocol server from three.ws. Install: `npx -y @three-ws/pumpfun-mcp`.

## Docs

- [README](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-mcp/blob/main/README.md): install, configuration, full reference
- [Documentation site](https://nirholas.github.io/pumpfun-mcp/): the README as a web page
- [Full text for LLMs](https://nirholas.github.io/pumpfun-mcp/llms-full.txt): README inlined
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/nirholas/pumpfun-mcp/blob/main/AGENTS.md): guidance for coding agents
